items: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Wear your ring of visibility and your ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs, or you can't see the ghosts. Then talk to the Mysterious Ghost outside Glarial's Tomb, north-west of the Fishing Guild. Ghosts don't show on the minimap.
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Talk to the Mysterious Ghost Rennard. Where he is depends on the first ghost's hint (ask that ghost again if you missed it). Route 1, pirates and a shipwreck: by the shipwreck near the Wilderness Agility Course, level 52 Wilderness. Route 2, north-east: the Bandit Camp in the Wilderness. Route 3, south-east: the Bandit Camp in the desert. Stay on the same route for every ghost.
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Talk to the Mysterious Ghost Kharrim. Route 1: the Chaos Temple, level 38 Wilderness. Route 2: the Graveyard of Shadows in the Wilderness. Route 3: the centre of the Lava Maze (bring a knife or slash weapon for the webs).
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Talk to the Mysterious Ghost Lennissa. Route 1: the church on Entrana (wear a Ghostspeak amulet, as Morytania legs aren't allowed there). Route 2: the south of the Port Sarim docks. Route 3: the west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Talk to the Mysterious Ghost Dhalak. Route 1: the ground floor of the Wizards' Tower. Route 2: upstairs in the Edgeville Monastery (needs 31 Prayer). Route 3: upstairs in the Falador Party Room.
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better

st.t: Talk to the Mysterious Ghost Viggora. Route 1: upstairs in the Rogues' Castle, level 54 Wilderness. Route 2: upstairs in the Slayer Tower, near the Infernal Mages. Route 3: in the Edgeville Wilderness Dungeon, near the Earth Warriors.
i: Ghostspeak amulet or Morytania legs 2 or better
